    # Tone Repetition Amplitude Analysis Across Sleep Stages
# This script compares linear trends vs. step functions for component amplitudes
---

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(bayestestR)
library(car)
library(effects)
library(gridExtra)

# Source helper functions
source("slope_helper_functions.R")
```

```{r}
# Define the components and variables (same as LME_analy.Rmd)
input_dir = "D:\\OExpOut\\adapt_res\\results\\lme"
output_dir = "D:\\OExpOut\\adapt_res\\results\\lme"

components <- c("N100", "P2", "N350")
sov_of_interest <-  c('wn', 'N1', 'N2', 'N3', 'REM','tREM', 'pREM')  #
output_prefix <- "wnN123REMs_"  #

all_results <- list()

for (component in components) {
  cat(paste0("\n========================================\n"))
  cat(paste0("Analyzing component: ", component, "\n"))
  cat(paste0("========================================\n"))

  # Load data (same format as LME_analy.Rmd)
  data_table <- read.csv(paste0(input_dir, "\\component_amplitudes.csv"))
  data_table <- data_table[data_table$comp == component, ]
  data_table <- data_table[!is.na(data_table$is_peak), ]
  data_table <- data_table[data_table$sov %in% sov_of_interest, ]
  data_table <- data_table[!is.na(data_table$amplitude) & !is.nan(data_table$amplitude), ]

  # Convert variables to factors
  data_table$sov <- factor(data_table$sov, levels = sov_of_interest, ordered = FALSE)
  data_table$sub <- factor(data_table$sub, ordered = FALSE)
  data_table$trial_pos <- factor(substr(data_table$cond, nchar(data_table$cond), nchar(data_table$cond)))
  data_table$is_peak <- factor(data_table$is_peak, levels = c(0, 1), ordered = FALSE)
  data_table$amplitude <- as.numeric(data_table$amplitude)

  # Make trial_pos numeric for trend analysis
  data_table$trial_pos_num <- as.numeric(as.character(data_table$trial_pos))

  # Keep only trials with peaks
  data_table <- data_table[data_table$is_peak == 1, ]

  # Split data by sleep stage
  stage_data <- split(data_table, data_table$sov)

  # Run analysis for each sleep stage
  results <- list()

  for (stage_name in names(stage_data)) {
    stage_subset <- stage_data[[stage_name]]

    if (nrow(stage_subset) > 0 && length(unique(stage_subset$sub)) >= 3) {
      cat(paste0("Analyzing ", component, " in stage ", stage_name, "...\n"))
      result <- compare_models(stage_subset, component, stage_name)
      results[[stage_name]] <- result
    } else {
      cat(paste0("Skipping ", component, " in stage ", stage_name,
                " (insufficient data: ", nrow(stage_subset), " observations from ",
                length(unique(stage_subset$sub)), " subjects)\n"))
    }
  }

  # Create summary table
  summary_table <- create_summary_table(results)

  # Write detailed results
  write_detailed_results(results, component, output_dir)

  # Create and save plots with ONLY the winning model
  plot_winning_model(stage_data, component, results, output_dir)

  # Store results
  all_results[[component]] <- list(results = results, summary = summary_table)
}

# Create overall summary table
all_summaries <- lapply(all_results, function(x) x$summary)
overall_summary <- do.call(rbind, all_summaries)
write.csv(overall_summary, paste0(output_dir, "\\slope_", output_prefix, "summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nAnalysis complete. Results saved to files.\n")
```
